definitions: A software system or service that enables users to conduct A/B tests, comparing two versions of a webpage, app feature, or other digital content to determine which performs better.
A tool used in marketing and product development to optimize user experience and conversion rates through controlled experimentation.
examples: Our team uses an A/B platform to test new website layouts.
Choosing the right A/B platform is crucial for data-driven decisions.
The A/B platform provided insights into user preferences.
